issues.claim: The BCL follows a similar idea: a method that only reads elements can accept `IReadOnlyList<T>` instead of `IList<T>`.
issues.problem: The IReadOnlyList<T> excerpt only shows that it is a read-only list interface. It does not mention ISP, so the 'follows a similar idea' framing is the author's interpretation, though it is reasonable and technically correct.
issues.suggestedFix: Soften to 'In the same spirit, a method that only reads elements can accept `IReadOnlyList<T>` instead of `IList<T>`.' Make the same change in RU.
